This sub was created as a general news sub, as well as a place to post general Souls-series questions. This is to remove clutter in subs pertaining to newly-announced souls games, for example Dark Souls 3. When it was first announced, all Souls subreddits became cluttered with news and announcements and footage, until a subreddit for Dark Souls 3 was created. This will help alleviate those posts, and keep all of the Souls subs pertinent to their original topics.

This sub, however, is not for information, OC, and questions regarding one specific game. Those belong in their respected subs, which can be found below. If anyone has any questions, feel free to post below in the comments, otherwise, enjoy your stay in the various Souls subs!

  • Demon's Souls
  • Dark Souls
  • Dark Souls 2
  • Dark Souls 3
